unlisted_practices: LLM chatbot restricted to WHO Self-Help Plus content under predefined guardrails
Workplace mental health chatbot usability and engagement evaluation

screen.reason: This is a feasibility study protocol for deploying an LLM-augmented mental health chatbot (TETI) to real users (workplace staff). While predefined guardrails are mentioned as part of the system design, the study evaluates overall feasibility, usability, and acceptability rather than testing a deployment practice or guardrail.
